title: VTA WebVH DIDs Keys List — payload
description: List a did:webvh's keys by role, with their state, and optionally the DID's rotation history and any changes awaiting approval.

did.description: The DID whose key roles are listed.

roles.description: Return only these roles. Absent returns every role. Present-but-empty is refused by the schema rather than read as 'every role' — emptiness is never a wildcard.

includeEnded.description: Include `retired` and `revoked` keys. Absent reads as false. `revoked` keys still published in `verificationMethod` are always included, because the document shows them to anyone who resolves it.

includeHistory.description: Include the DID's rotation history. Absent reads as false.

Response.title: VTA WebVH DIDs Keys List — response payload

versionId.description: The log entry the answer describes. Pass it as `expectedVersionId` to a change made on the strength of this answer.

roles.description: One entry per role asked for, including roles with no keys — an empty role is an answer, and omitting it would read as 'not asked'.

rotations.description: Present exactly when `includeHistory` was true. Newest first. In the custody projection this includes changes in `pendingApproval`; in the public projection it includes only changes that published an entry.
